claim: The readings line for 差 prints the same syllable on both sides of the slash, so it looks like a copy error rather than an on reading and a kun stem that happen to match.
evidence: Reading back: '差 / Answer: Difference / Says: sa / sa'. Other kanji in the chapter show distinct sides, e.g. '泣 ... Says: kyū / na', '怒 ... Says: do / ika, oko'.
fix: Show the kun reading with its okurigana marked (e.g. 'sa / sa(su)') so the two sides read as two different readings.
verdictReason: The card follows the deck convention in src/reading/readingSchemes.js, where a kun reading is only the part the kanji is read as (き for 聞く), as on 泣 kyū / na; KANJIDIC2 gives 差 on サ and kun さ.す, so sa / sa is correct data, and showing okurigana would be a deck-wide format change, not a fix to this card.

claim: 一度 reads just as naturally as 'one degree' as it does 'once', because the learner knows 度 as 'Degrees (temperature)' and meets 三十度 '30 degrees' in this same chapter, but the back accepts only 'Once'.
evidence: Reading back: '一度 / Answer: Once / Says: ichido'. Ledger, Lesson 8: '度 | Degrees (temperature)'. This chapter: '三十度 / Answer: 30 degrees / Says: sanjū-do'.
fix: Gloss it 'Once; one time (also: one degree)' so a learner who reads it as a temperature is not marked wrong.
verdictReason: Faithful to the book, which teaches 一度 only as "once" (kanji 142 example) and teaches the temperature sense as 三十度; adding an untaught "one degree" sense breaks rule 1, and the root cause (the 度 card lacks the book sense "time") is chapter-9/r-304fce687a69/book-mismatch/1.

claim: This chapter teaches the kanji 度 as "time; degrees", but the one 度 card in the deck answers only "Degrees (temperature)", so the "time" sense it uses in 一度 and 今度 is carded nowhere.
evidence: Book, kanji 142: "度 (time; degrees) ▶ど 一度(いちど) once 今度(こんど) near future 温度 ... 三十度 ... 態度". reading-report.json drops 度 here as "already carded in Chapter 10: Lesson 8". Card chapter-9 r-304fce687a69: 度 "Degrees (temperature)" (do, voiced).
fix: Change the English to carry both senses, e.g. "Time (occurrence); degrees".
verdictReason: Book kanji 142 reads 度 (time; degrees) with 一度 once and 今度 near future; reading-report.json drops 度 as already carded in Lesson 8, and the only 度 card in the collection, chapter-9 r-304fce687a69, answers "Degrees (temperature)", so the "time" sense is carded nowhere; rule 3 asks one item carrying both meanings.
